# Bounce — account brief

## Who

Bounce runs a network of luggage storage locations in cities around the world ([source](https://usebounce.com/)). Its GitHub org is listed as Bounce at usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).

## Production Expo signals

- The `bounce-app` repo contains an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 14 public repos and 96 followers ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).
- `bounce-app` last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)).
- The iOS app has 12,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).
- There were 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@usebounce-maintainer-1), top contributor to `bounce-app` with 118 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company Bounce, location Remote, website https://usebounce.com, and the bio "Mobile engineer at Bounce. Maintains the Bounce app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@usebounce-maintainer-2), 64 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company Bounce, location New York, NY, website https://usebounce.com, and the bio "React Native developer on the Bounce mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Bounce app." ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@usebounce-maintainer-3), 22 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company Bounce, location San Francisco, CA, website https://usebounce.com, and the bio "Engineer at Bounce. Mostly the Bounce app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3))

## Why now

`bounce-app` last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)) and the iOS app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer Two, your profile says you handle EAS builds and releases for the Bounce app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)). The repo carries an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). At that cadence, where does the handoff between your GitHub workflows and EAS sit today?
